notes.title: [TGS2025] ‘The Touhou Empires’ DEMO Version is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
We are the development team "Neetpia" for ‘The Touhou Empires’.

To coincide with the TGS2025 taking place from September 25 to 28, the DEMO version of our title is now available!

We are continuously refining and polishing the game for its release later this year.
We are eager to hear your feedback and opinions, so please share them in our Steam community page or join us on Discord!

------------------------------------
⚔ New Features & Improvements  ⚔

- Improved gameplay and controls.
- Completely revamped the intermission system in Story Mode
- New factions
- Major changes to 3D graphics
Other significant changes...?



Please don’t upload game play video about this version because of significant changes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42337440/90785cc8af22f72f5e30ccd26e8319f33b37be24.png"]
⚔ Modes and Characters Available in This Demo  ⚔

In this version, you can play the following modes:

- Alice’s Art of War: A mission mode where you clear assigned challenges.
- Story Mode: Playable up to Chapter 3.
- Battle Mode: A skirmish mode where you can fight against the computer.
- Online Mode: A multiplayer mode supporting up to 6 players, including public and private lobbies as well as a 1v1 ranked mode!

Please note that this is a demo version still in development. Therefore, features in various modes, including Battle Mode, are limited.

The available factions (civilizations) are:
- Hakurei Shrine
- Scarlet Devil Manor
- Hakugyokurou
(You can control heroines associated with each civilization.)
Additionally, the only selectable map is Grasslands.

(In the full version, we plan to include around 40 playable characters, 12 civilizations, and approximately 8 maps.)

While this version is nearing completion, we aim to improve its quality by incorporating your feedback.

If you are interested, we would love to hear from you!
Please share your opinions and impressions in the Steam Community or on our official Discord server (details below).

------------------------------------
⚔ Stay Updated on Discord!  ⚔
Get the latest news here!

Feel free to use Discord not only to share your thoughts and suggestions on the demo version but also as a place to connect with others for online play after the official release.

▼Click the banner below to join▼
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42337440/c93e2a6135abb7aa0440cf0065a600486d5574c6.png"]

notes.title: Limited Time "Demo Version" - Next Battlefield is "PAX EAST"
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are the development team "Neetpia" for "The Touhou Empires."

With the participation in today's "PAX EAST" event,
We have re-released the demo version for those strong souls who are interested!

------------------------------------------------------

⚔ Prelude (Demo Version), Once Again! ⚔

During the "PAX EAST" event period mentioned above,
The "Special Demo Version" of "The Touhou Empires" will once again be made available!

While there haven't been significant changes from the previous demo version, we have been refining various aspects continuously.
We eagerly await your feedback and opinions, so please feel free to share them in the community or join our Discord server!

------------------------------------

⚔ Characters Available in this Demo ⚔

In this version, you can enjoy the following modes:

・Mission mode "Alice’s Art of War" where you clear challenges
・"Story Mode" playable up to Chapter 3
・"Battle Mode" where up to six players engage in combat (currently CPU battles only, and the selectable faction is limited to the "Hakurei Shrine")

Since this is a demo version under development, the "Battle Mode" is limited to "CPU battles" only. The available faction (civilization) is limited to "One faction of the Hakurei Shrine," and you can control up to "Three heroines of the Hakurei Shrine."

The selectable map is only "Grassland."

(In the final version, there will be online battles between users, around 40 playable characters, approximately 12 selectable factions, and up to 8 maps.)

Though it is still a work in progress, we aim to improve the completeness by incorporating your feedback.

We eagerly await the opinions of those who believe they have what it takes!

Please share your thoughts and feedback on the "Steam Community" or our official Discord server below.

------------------------------------

⚔ Information Network (Discord) Running Smoothly! ⚔

Our "Official Discord Server," established since last year, has gathered over 650 warriors!

Feel free to use it not only for sharing your thoughts and requests about the demo version but also as a leisure space for online play after the release.
